decisions.reason: Two-component resin injection draws directly on the firm's plural-component dosing and pumping know-how, so it can still improve the unit in-house, though its absence from the website in 2020-2021 raises some doubt.
It rests on the same core plural-component knowledge, but its overlap with Product A and its lack of recent website presence make consolidation more likely than for the other lines.
Automatic airless guns sit at the centre of the firm's spray application expertise and in-house manufacturing, giving it strong capacity to read field results and refine the product.
Manual airless guns are a core accessory tied to the firm's existing pumps, service network and customers, so learning from feedback and keeping the product going is straightforward.
The air-assisted airless gun line extends established spray technology for industrial coating customers, but a multi-model line may be pruned if some variants lag.
